title: I Let the Drive-Thru Speaker Catch the Dare They Thought Was Private

parts.text: I took the order at 9:41 p.m. and the car two back dared the driver to call me a name when they reached the window. The speaker was still hot. I was twenty-two, headset on, holding a cup. I packed the food correctly. I also packed the receipt with a note: speaker was live, dare was recorded per the store poster. They went quiet at the window. They paid. They did not call me the name. The poster has been there since before their dare. I dropped the headset at 10, washed the headset smell off, and ate a leftover fry that was mine. Live mics are a kind of lighting. Dares should read signs. The cup stayed in the car. My name stayed mine.

social.video_title: The dare hit a live speaker and a poster — Part 1/1
social.description: Night window, packed correctly, receipt note. They paid quiet. Have you heard a dare meant for you?
